title: If this is real right now
intro: You don't need perfect words. Being there matters. Here's what to do.

steps.title: Stay with them
steps.body: Keep talking or texting. Let them know you're glad they told you.

steps.title: Ask directly
steps.body: It's okay to ask: "Are you thinking about killing yourself?" Asking does not put the idea in their head. It shows you care and opens the door.

steps.title: Listen without judging
steps.body: Let them talk. Don't argue, lecture, or promise everything will be fine.

steps.title: Don't keep it a secret
steps.body: Never promise to keep thoughts of suicide a secret. Their safety matters more than a promise.

steps.title: Tell a trusted adult today
steps.body: A parent, school counselor, teacher, coach, or another adult you trust. Offer to go with them.

steps.title: Call or text 988
steps.body: In the US, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). It's free and open 24/7, and you can call about a friend too.

steps.title: If they're in immediate danger, call 911
steps.body: If they might act on it right now or have already hurt themselves, call 911 and stay with them if it's safe.

for_you: Supporting a friend is heavy. Talk to someone you trust about how you're feeling too.
disclaimer: Unsent is a practice tool, not a crisis service or therapy.
